One may exclude close-together events or those undergoing large angle scatter from the Compton analysis to achieve better angular resolution in the overall data reconstruction. Such algorithmic decisions have never been thoroughly studied in the SDF framework, but may be well-suited to coupling with other sorts of contextually-informed analyses that are enabled by SDF and could benefit SDF applications. Compton-capable LAMP systems have generally had coincident-pair efficiencies that are few-fold to ten-fold less efficient than the singles efficiency, dependent on energy. Anecdotal experience with Compton imaging systems has suggested that their reduced efficacy, relative to more efficient detection systems, reduces efficacy in scenarios where real-time feedback is available and unconstrained movement possible.
